videos.topic: two words heavy on the Scale
videos.title: 2 Words Heavy on the Scale
videos.title_en: 2 Words Light on the Tongue, Heavy on the Scale
videos.caption: Seconds to say, heavy on the Scale on the Day it matters most 🤍 Say them now and comment SubhanAllah 👇

sources.wording: English rendering of: kalimatani khafifatani 'ala al-lisan, thaqilatani fi al-mizan, habibatani ila ar-Rahman: subhan Allah al-'azim, subhan Allah wa bihamdih (6406 order)

lines.text: These {two phrases} take seconds to say…
lines.text2: یہ {دو کلمے} کہنے میں چند سیکنڈ لگتے ہیں…
lines.say: These two phrases | take seconds to say,
yet they are *heavy* on the Scale.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: Two words are {light} on the tongue,
lines.say: Two words are *light* on the tongue,

lines.sub: SubhanAllahil-'Azim — Glory be to Allah, the Most Great
lines.say: Glory be to Allah, the Most Great.

lines.sub: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi — Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him (Sahih al-Bukhari 6406)
lines.say: Glory be to Allah, | and praise be to Him.

lines.text: Say them {now}, while you still have time.
lines.text2: ابھی {کہہ لیں}، جب تک وقت ہے۔
lines.say: Say them *now*, | while you still have time.

lines.label: Allah says
lines.sub: “And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection” (Al-Anbya 21:47)
lines.say: And We place the scales of justice | for the Day of Resurrection.
Comment SubhanAllah | when you've said them.
